name: fullstackopen-relational-blog
description: Full Stack Open relational databases: Chapter 2 exercises 1–4

scripts.db:psql: docker compose exec db psql -U bloguser -d blogdb
scripts.db:seed: docker compose exec -T db psql -U bloguser -d blogdb -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 < commands.sql
scripts.db:test:create: docker compose exec -T db psql -U bloguser -d postgres -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -c 'CREATE DATABASE blogdb_test;'
